tagline: Elevating the way we feed our pets with fresh food that nourishes all.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net Sales is the primary indicator of the company's growth, reflecting increasing consumer adoption of its products and expansion of its distribution network.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total sales of fresh pet food products to retailers.
kpis.description: Net sales increased by 13.0% to reach $1.102 billion in 2025, primarily driven by growth in grocery, mass, international, and digital channels.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by channel expansion and increased sales.

kpis.name: Gross Profit Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting the cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross profit margin was 40.8% of net sales in 2025, reflecting effective management of product and ingredient costs.
kpis.signal: Stable gross margin, indicating sound production cost management.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from the company's core operations before interest and taxes.
kpis.description: Operating income more than doubled, rising from $38.0 million in 2024 to $75.7 million in 2025, driven by higher sales and effective cost management.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Final profit after all expenses, including taxes and interest.
kpis.description: Net income tripled in 2025 to reach $139.1 million, benefiting from a significant $68.8 million deferred tax asset valuation allowance release and operational improvements.

kpis.name: Number of Freshpet Fridges Installed
kpis.explanation: Total number of Freshpet-branded refrigerators deployed in retail stores.
kpis.description: The company continued expanding its Freshpet fridge network, reaching 30,235 retail stores by the end of 2025, supporting product availability and visibility.
kpis.signal: Ongoing expansion of physical distribution network.

kpis.short: Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance Release
kpis.name: Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance Release
kpis.explanation: Amount of previously recorded allowance for deferred tax assets no longer deemed necessary.
kpis.description: A $68.8 million release of the deferred tax assets valuation allowance was recognized in 2025, reflecting confidence in the future realization of these assets based on three years of cumulative profitability.
kpis.signal: Positive indicator of anticipated future profitability.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $1.102 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS of $2.64 in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Percentage increase in net sales compared to the prior year.
kpis.description: Net sales increased by 13.0% in 2025, demonstrating growing demand for Freshpet products and the effectiveness of its expansion strategy.
kpis.signal: Steady growth in the fresh pet food market.

kpis.name: Volume Gains
kpis.explanation: Increase in the number of units sold, independent of price changes.
kpis.description: Volume gains of 12.0% in 2025 indicate increased consumer adoption of Freshpet products beyond simple price adjustments.

kpis.name: Price/Mix Favorable
kpis.explanation: Positive impact from price changes and sales mix on revenue.
kpis.description: A favorable price/mix impact of 1.0% in 2025 contributed to revenue growth, suggesting an effective pricing strategy and strong product acceptance.
kpis.signal: Modest but positive contribution from pricing and product mix.

risks.title: Dependence on Retailers and Freshpet Fridges for Sales
risks.summary: The company relies heavily on its network of Freshpet refrigerators in retail stores for sales. A failure in this network or deterioration in retailer relationships could negatively impact sales.
risks.score_rationale: The document indicates that sales are primarily conducted through Freshpet refrigerators in retail stores. Dependence on this unique network and retailer relationships constitutes a significant industry risk. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Volatility in Input Costs and Pricing
risks.summary: Costs of ingredients and packaging materials may fluctuate, affecting profitability. The company attempts to offset this through price increases, which could impact demand.
risks.score_rationale: The document states that the company raises prices to offset unfavorable input cost movements. Managing these costs and their impact on gross margin are recurring concerns. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: High Marketing and Advertising Expenses
risks.summary: The company invests heavily in marketing and advertising to drive brand awareness and demand. These high costs could pressure financial results if sales growth slows.
risks.score_rationale: Marketing and advertising expenses are a significant component of selling, general, and administrative expenses, focused on building brand awareness and demand. These expenditures are necessary for growth but weigh on profitability. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risks Related to Freshpet Fridge Warranties
risks.summary: Costs associated with repairs and maintenance of Freshpet refrigerators, particularly those covered under warranties, could affect operating expenses.
risks.score_rationale: Refrigerators purchased before 2025 carry a three-year warranty, while those from 2025 have a five-year warranty. Maintenance and repair costs related to these warranties represent an operational risk. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Management of Deferred Taxes and Asset Valuation
risks.summary: The company adjusted its deferred tax valuation allowance in 2025, releasing $68.8 million. The ability to maintain future profitability is critical to sustaining this position.
risks.score_rationale: The company released the majority of its deferred tax valuation allowance in 2025, based on three years of cumulative profitability. Future management of these tax assets and liabilities, and the sustainability of profitability, remain key considerations. (default score, to be refined)
